data.description: Entity data. Task: {title, start, end, location, allday, text, priority, tags, category, calendar}. Contact: {name, fields: {Vorname, Nachname, Telefon, E-Mail, ...}, tags}. Note: {title, text, tab_name, tree, tags}. Todo: {title, start, end, priority, text, tags, list}. Password: {subject, fields: {key: value, ...}, tags, group_id}. category, calendar, tree and list take the NAME from your instructions.
